param(
    [string]$ComputerName = 'localhost',
    [PSCredential]$Credential = $null
)

try {
    # Attempt remote reboot using WS-Man protocol
    Invoke-Command -ComputerName $ComputerName -ScriptBlock {
        Restart-Computer -Force
    } -ErrorAction Stop

}

    Write-Error 'Failed to initiate remote reboot' -ErrorRecord $_
}
finally {
    # Optional: Add cleanup or logging here if needed
}

# Script: Get-SystemInformation.ps1
# Version: 1.0
# Description: Self-contained PowerShell script to gather system information

param(
    [switch]$ShowConsole = $false,
    [switch]$SaveFile = $false
)

# Gather system information
$systemInfo = @{
    'Uptime' = (Get-ComputerInfo).SystemBootTime
    'DiskSpace' = (Get-PSDrive -PSDrive C).DriveInfo.DiskSize / 1GB
    'Memory' = (Get-MemInfo).TotalMegabytes
    'CPU' = (Get-CpuInfo).Name
}

# Display information
If ($ShowConsole) {
    Write-Host 'System Information:'
    foreach ($key in $systemInfo.Keys) {
        Write-Host "`t$key: $($systemInfo[$key])"
    }
}

# Save to file
If ($SaveFile) {
    $outputPath = "C:\Temp\SystemInfo_$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMddHHmmss')).txt"
    $systemInfo | Out-File -FilePath $outputPath
    Write-Host "Information saved to: $outputPath"
}

# Return results
$systemInfo

```powershell
# Set execution policy to allow script execution
Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Force

# Get system information
function Get-SystemInfo {
    try {
        # Operating System Information
        $osInfo = Get-ComputerInfo |
            Select-Object -Property OSName, Version, BuildNumber

        # Hardware Information
        $cpuInfo = Get-CpuInfo |
            Select-Object -Property Manufacturer, MaxClockSpeed
        $memoryInfo = Get-PhysicalMemory |
            Select-Object -Property Manufacturer, Speed, Capacity

        # Disk Information
        $diskInfo = Get-PSDrive -DriveType Disk |
            Select-Object -Property Name, Size, Used, Free

        # Running Services
        $services = Get-Service | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq 'Running' } |
            Select-Object -Property Name, DisplayName, StartType

        # Network Configuration
        $network = Get-NetIPAddress |
            Select-Object -Property IPAddress, DefaultGateway, DNS

        # PowerShell Version
        $psVersion = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion

        # Execution Policy
        $executionPolicy = Get-ExecutionPolicy

        # Display all information
        Write-Host 'System Information:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        Write-Host "OS: $($osInfo.OSName)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host "Version: $($osInfo.Version)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host "Build: $($osInfo.BuildNumber)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        Write-Host ''

        Write-Host 'Processor Information:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        foreach ($cpu in $cpuInfo) {
            Write-Host "Manufacturer: $($cpu.Manufacturer)"
            Write-Host "Max Speed: $($cpu.MaxClockSpeed) MHz"
            Write-Host ''
        }

        Write-Host 'Memory Information:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        foreach ($memory in $memoryInfo) {
            Write-Host "Manufacturer: $($memory.Manufacturer)"
            Write-Host "Speed: $($memory.Speed) MHz"
            Write-Host "Capacity: $(($memory.Capacity / 1GB).ToString('N2')) GB"
            Write-Host ''
        }

        Write-Host 'Disk Information:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        foreach ($disk in $diskInfo) {
            Write-Host "Drive: $($disk.Name)"
            Write-Host "Size: $(($disk.Size / 1GB).ToString('N2')) GB"
            Write-Host "Used: $(($disk.Used / 1GB).ToString('N2')) GB"
            Write-Host "Free: $(($disk.Free / 1GB).ToString('N2')) GB"
            Write-Host ''
        }

        Write-Host 'Running Services:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        foreach ($service in $services) {
            Write-Host "Name: $($service.Name)"
            Write-Host "Display Name: $($service.DisplayName)"
            Write-Host "Start Type: $($service.StartType)"
            Write-Host ''
        }

        Write-Host 'Network Configuration:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        foreach ($ip in $network) {
            Write-Host "IP Address: $($ip.IPAddress)"
            Write-Host "Default Gateway: $($ip.DefaultGateway)"
            Write-Host "DNS Servers: $($ip.DNS -join ', ')"
            Write-Host ''
        }

        Write-Host 'PowerShell Version:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        Write-Host "Version: $($psVersion.Major).$($psVersion.Minor).$($psVersion.Build)"
        Write-Host ''

        Write-Host 'Execution Policy:'
        Write-Host '------------------------'
        Write-Host "Policy: $executionPolicy"
    } catch {
        Write-Error "Error gathering system information: $_.Exception.Message"
    }
}

# Execute the function
Get-SystemInfo
```
